rows.evidence: Q1: Sections 2-4 report the authors' own data processing, machine-learning model runs (Table 3), CDF matching and validation of 3-m surface soil moisture predictions against in situ Yanco network and HDAS measurements (Tables 5-6, Figure 5).
rows.notes: The study develops and validates a method for downscaling SMAP soil moisture to 3-m resolution using Planet SuperDove imagery; it reports accuracy of surface soil moisture maps (RMSE, bias, correlation vs in situ) and qualitative capture of irrigation and vegetation-related wetness patterns. It does not report any result on soil management or soil quality maintenance; those applications (precision agriculture, water resources management) are only mentioned as potential uses in the Abstract, Discussion and Conclusions. Mapping soil moisture is at most a precondition for the claimed soil-management/soil-quality effect, so Q2 is no and upstream is set to true.

notes: Full text appears complete, though some pages are duplicated/garbled by layout (overlapping columns). The study concerns soil moisture mapping only; nothing in it evaluates soil quality or soil management outcomes.
